/bin/zsh -lc "rtk python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess, collections
raw=subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain=v1','-z','--untracked-files=all'])
records=[x for x in raw.decode().split('\\0') if x]
paths=[]
for row in records:
    paths.append(row[3:] if len(row)>=4 else row)
counts=collections.Counter(p.split('/',1)[0] for p in paths)
print('status_path_count',len(paths))
print('path_groups',dict(counts))
print('non_QA_paths',[p for p in paths if not p.startswith('QA/')])
print('QA_path_count',sum(p.startswith('QA/') for p in paths))
PY"
